Class BudgetManager

java.lang.Object
com.duck.model.records.BudgetManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
PropertyChangeListener, EventListener
public class BudgetManager extends Object implements PropertyChangeListener
Manages all Budget objects for the application. Supports creating, editing, and querying budgets per account. Listens for TransactionEvent to track spending against active budgets and fires BudgetEvent alerts when thresholds or limits are exceeded.

    • editBudget

      public AppSettings.Message editBudget(Budget budget, Budget updatedBudget)
      Edits an existing budget by replacing it with an updated version after re-validation. The account must remain unchanged.
      Parameters:
      budget - the original budget to replace
      updatedBudget - the new budget data
      Returns:
      SUCCESS or the appropriate error Message

    • propertyChange

      public void propertyChange(PropertyChangeEvent evt)
      Handles property change events. Responds to TRANSACTION_RECEIVED by updating budget used amounts, and to TOKEN_CHANGED by loading or clearing persisted budget data.
